implementation_summary:
This change implements a standard release preparation workflow for the instructor Python library. The approach follows established semantic versioning practices where a patch version increment (1.14.3 → 1.14.4) indicates backward-compatible bug fixes.

The implementation updates version information in three key locations: pyproject.toml (the project's build configuration), instructor/__init__.py (runtime package metadata), and uv.lock (dependency lock file). This multi-file synchronization ensures consistency across build tools, runtime imports, and dependency resolution systems.

The changelog update follows the Keep a Changelog format with clear section headers (Changed, Fixed) and includes specific pull request references (#2000, #2002, etc.) for traceability. The entries document both new functionality (JsonCompleteness simplification) and bug fixes (Google GenAI safety settings, Responses API retries, list[T] response models). This structured approach to release management integrates well with the existing CI/CD infrastructure mentioned in the architectural summary, supporting automated testing and publishing workflows.
